owns.viewport-zoom: The infinite desktop is a physics world driven by pinch and drag; browser zoom fights the camera and the window manager. A deliberate choice until the world handles zoom.
owns.motion: Physics-first world: window springs, star drift, nova bursts and game feedback run on their own clocks (100 ms to 100 s), not the 120–200 ms UI range.
owns.colour: Game apps and window controls carry their own fixed palettes (2048 tiles, Wordl cells, traffic lights) that do not follow the theme.
